paperClaim: The frozen external challenge set contains 413 model-visible request-side samples with AI-adjudicated reference labels.
limitations: Reference labels are AI-annotated + AI-adjudicated, NOT human-verified ground truth; the set is an authorized challenge capture, not natural production traffic.
allowedWording: The frozen evaluation contains 413 request-side samples (safe=209, attack=97, unknown=107).
forbiddenWording: The benchmark is representative production traffic or human ground truth.

paperClaim: The primary model (aetherargus-v02-hf-lora) achieved the reported verdict scores on the frozen set.
limitations: Single frozen set; 95% CI is a finite-sample bootstrap, not a population guarantee.
allowedWording: aetherargus-v02-hf-lora achieved accuracy 0.6150 (95% CI 0.5835-0.6441) and macro-F1 0.4658 (95% CI 0.4415-0.4894).
forbiddenWording: aetherargus-v02-hf-lora is universally more capable than every baseline in all deployments.

paperClaim: aetherargus-v02-hf-lora's observed safe false-positive rate and its exact 95% interval.
limitations: An observed low rate is not proof of low population risk; the Clopper-Pearson interval quantifies finite-sample uncertainty.
allowedWording: Observed safe FPR was 43/209 (Clopper-Pearson 95% upper bound 0.2670).
forbiddenWording: The model has no false positives or a guaranteed population FPR.

paperClaim: aetherargus-v02-hf-lora versus the strongest non-AetherArgus baseline on paired significance tests.
limitations: The baseline set is rules-baseline; char-ngram-logreg; qwen3-4b-zero-shot; qwen3-4b-few-shot. Significance applies only to this frozen set.
allowedWording: Against the strongest baseline by verdict macro-F1 (qwen3-4b-zero-shot), AetherArgus HF-LoRA had macro-F1 delta +0.0482 (paired 95% CI [+0.0113,+0.0835]) and Holm-adjusted McNemar p=8.36e-7.
forbiddenWording: AetherArgus is universally more capable than Qwen3-4B or every baseline.
